models.name: bronze wyrm
models.description: A stabled dragon breed: lean, teal-green with golden belly plates, swept horns and wings raised high; skinned on the young dragon's rig, painted atlas, the city's code-built skull.
models.cite: the iamar browser source (not public) 8a152539 MpDragonKit breed bronze_wyrm (LOD0, code-built skull) (kit/catalog/assets/export_city_mounts.gd)

models.name: giant eagle
models.description: The city's giant riding eagle: white head, brown wings with spread primaries, skinned (23 bones), painted feathers; the code-built head (the city's own generated head is not shipped, its licence is unconfirmed).
models.cite: the iamar browser source (not public) 8a152539 MpBirdKit (LOD0, code-built head) (kit/catalog/assets/export_city_mounts.gd)

models.name: griffin

models.cite: the iamar browser source (not public) 8a152539 MpGriffinKit (LOD0, code-built head) (kit/catalog/assets/export_city_mounts.gd)
